conventions.chemical_scale: Shared bond length; never equal molecular bounding boxes.
conventions.orientation: Explicit shared-scaffold alignment; never infer stereochemistry from orientation.
conventions.charges: Native CirclePlus/Minus linked to existing formal charges, using the symbols workflow.
conventions.electron_flow: Explicit electron source and target; charge or lone-pair source where appropriate.
conventions.review: Native chemistry/layout checks plus human visual review. Not a chemical correctness certificate.
